content.text: I'll analyze the request. The data model has a `watched` flag on `WatchItem` (the "seen" concept — the store even tracks `watchedCount`). So the request maps to: a store mutation that removes all watched items, plus a button on the watchlist page wired to it. Two units need to change: `watchlist-store` (new mutation, persisted like the others) and `watchlist` (the button).

input.reason: The watchlist's "seen" concept is the WatchItem.watched flag. Add a WatchlistStore.clearWatched() mutation that removes all watched items (persisting like remove/toggleWatched), and render a "Clear watched" button on the watchlist page that calls it. No other units are affected.

steps.instruction: Add a public method `clearWatched()` that removes every item whose `watched` flag is true from the stored watchlist. Requirements: (1) items with `watched === false` must remain, in their current relative order; (2) the derived signals must update accordingly — after the call `watchedCount()` is 0 and `count()` equals the number of remaining items; (3) persist the new list to localStorage exactly the way remove()/toggleWatched() do, so a freshly constructed WatchlistStore sees the cleared state; (4) calling it when nothing is watched, or on an empty list, must be a harmless no-op. Do not change the behaviour of add/remove/toggleWatched.

Add a button to the watchlist page template that clears every watched (seen) movie from the list. The WatchlistStore you already import now additionally exposes `clearWatched(): void`, which removes all watched items and persists the result — call that; do not re-implement the filtering in the component. Requirements: (1) the button must be a `<button>` element with the static attribute `data-testid="clear-watched"` and human-readable text (e.g. "Clear watched"); (2) it must be rendered and clickable whenever at least one movie in the list is watched (watchedCount() > 0); (3) place it outside the table/list rows, i.e. not inside any element with a row-click handler, so clicking it triggers only the clear action and never onRowClick; (4) add a public component method `clearWatched(): void` that delegates to the store and updates the `announcement` signal in the same style as remove()/toggleWatched() do, so the action is announced to screen readers; wire the button's click to this method. Do not change the existing behaviour of remove(), toggleWatched(), onRowClick() or the progress display.

content.text: I'll add the "Clear watched" button (outside the list rows), a `clearWatched()` component method that delegates to the store and announces the action, plus tests for the new behavior.
